digest.component_or_area: close STATUS event metadata / completion verification gate
propositions: A reader cannot distinguish closed-without-signature from gate-off on read because gate state at close time is read from config and discarded, collapsing multiple distinct close reasons into one observable state.

completion_expectation enum (8 values: required, disposition, gate_off, gate_unreadable, force_bypassed, local_source, not_certifiable, not_applicable) must be persisted on the *->closed STATUS event in the same locked write as the close, using the close_class/force_close_reason precedent.

The expectation is computed as the second return value of _completion_precheck (consuming GateState tri-state), threaded into transition_core as a keyword parameter, with gate state resolving first so force under disabled/unreadable records gate_off/gate_unreadable rather than force_bypassed.

A later reader combines durable expectation with durable attestation to distinguish: required + attestation = signed; required + none = signature lost; disposition +/- attestation = disposition cases; others = not expected with reason specified.

The field is present-only, backward-compatible, and reducer-folded on both *->closed edges; historical close events lacking the key reduce to state with the key absent (unknown, never guessed), with no migration.
